display_name: Precise ONNX + Silero VAD + speaker verifier (hey mycroft)
description: The full listener stack for 'hey mycroft' on Precise ONNX: a Silero pre-wake VAD gate, then the Precise recurrent detector, then a speaker-verification confirm.
notes: Combo fighter: pre-wake VAD + wake-word engine + verifier. Each distinct (engine, VAD, verifier) triple is its own competitor. 'hey mycroft' is used here (not 'hey jarvis') because it's the phrase precise-onnx shares with openWakeWord, keeping the comparison apples-to-apples on synthetic-wakewords-hey_mycroft.
